title: Classes that declare a parametrized abstract-collection base cannot be structured
title_original: Fix structuring of attrs class that inherit from typing/collections.abc generic type aliases
text_original: Fixes #654. The first commit reproduces the error `AttributeError: type object 'Iterable' has no attribute '__parameters__'`. I will follow up with the actual fix.
text_rewritten: Some of our models declare an abstract collection interface as a base class and parametrize it, e.g. a class that says it is an iterable of ints. Structuring such a model blows up with an AttributeError about a missing '__parameters__' attribute before any of our own code runs. The same model with the unparametrized interface as a base works fine, and so does a model with no interface base at all, so it is only the parametrized form that breaks. We are not asking for any new behaviour from the parameter itself - the fields should be structured exactly as they would be without the interface base.

acceptance_hint: A model whose base class is a parametrized abstract collection interface structures into the same value it would produce with an unparametrized base, on every shipped converter, and models with plain bases keep working.
